errors.text_span: 坐标轴类型为线性，采用10%的刻度间隔
errors.evidence: The x-axis scale is not linear, as the intervals between the tick marks (1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, 100%) are not uniform. Consequently, there is no fixed tick interval of 10%.
The y-axis has a tick interval of 2 (80, 82, 84, etc.), not 1. The description incorrectly lists the data point values as the axis tick values.
The data point on the chart for the x-value of 10% corresponds to a y-value of 90.88, not 88.

errors.text_span: 在坐标(20%, 90.88)处将其持续提高
errors.evidence: The data point on the chart for the x-value of 20% corresponds to a y-value of 91.96, not 90.88.
The description does not mention that the data points on the line are indicated by circular markers.
